Chill is an On Hit Effect status which can also be applied by some Skills.

- 1 Description

- 2 Known Modifiers

- 2.1 Character Stats

## Description[]

Chill reduces Melee Attack Speed, Throwing Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Movement Speed by 12%. An enemy can have up to three instances of chill at once.
